20:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Monday Night Kickoff
The legendary Monday Night Football crew of Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, and Lisa Salters preview the upcoming Monday Night Football action.

20:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NFL Football
The Eagles host the Cowboys in NFC East play at Lincoln Financial Field. Both sides sit at 2-4, but Philadelphia has dropped four straight heading into this divisional meeting and QB Jalen Hurts is out for the season due to a medical concern.
